dedupe_keys.name: tanzania climate sensitive waterborne diseases dataset for predictive machine learning a comprehensive five year analysis of health infrastructure and weather data 2019 2023

description: The Sokoine University of Agriculture team publishes anonymised infrastructure, disease and weather tables for five Tanzanian districts over 2019–2023. Zenodo provides CSV files free under CC BY 4.0. Variables concern water sources, toilets, healthcare locations and waste facilities, with waterborne-disease counts and monthly Copernicus weather data. These inputs can examine health-demand and sanitation-service assumptions in infrastructure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this collection. The provider expands infrastructure points to monthly rows, so repeated entries are not independent new observations. All location-revealing information is anonymised, limiting spatial linkage and site-level validation. The public inventory lists disease tables for four districts while infrastructure files cover five; disease completeness therefore remains uncertain. Variable coding, denominator consistency and causal relationships were not checked. No CSV was downloaded or predictive model trained.
